t: Mac & Devin Go to High School
d: Rappers Snoop Doog and Wiz Khalifa team up to create this ultimate stoner comedy with a star-studded hip hop soundtrack.
Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!
From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

A trio of university parapsychologists lose their research grant and decide to open their own business, "Ghostbusters," and almost at once are summoned to investigate the strange happenings in a Central Park West apartment.

Directed by Ivan Reitman. Starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis, Annie Potts. The Ghostbusters attempt to rid New York City of the slime and negative energy that plagues it.

Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.
